value_unit: fault-injection scenarios for tamper, stale lease, temporal leakage, sequence gaps, and queue/recovery failures
donor_symbol: Failure Domain Analysis & Fault Injection Matrix
decision_rationale: The scenarios expose useful negative paths, while donor implementation claims were unverified. They were converted into target-native tests over existing authoritative mechanisms.
invariant: tamper, stale authority, future context, and sequence gaps fail closed
negative_invariant: no fault may be silently treated as healthy evidence
license_note: conceptual test scenarios only; no donor code copied

donor_symbol: Complete API Endpoint Specification / JSON Schema Contracts
decision_rationale: Hand-written donor routes were inconsistent with source. The target now generates and freezes OpenAPI from the real FastAPI app and validates security and operation identifiers.
target_capability: deterministic API contract and drift gate
invariant: generated contract is deterministic and all non-health operations are authenticated
negative_invariant: hand-written documentation cannot redefine API truth
license_note: native implementation; no donor schema copied

value_unit: parametric Gaussian and Cornish-Fisher tail-risk variants
donor_symbol: Mathematical Formulation of Portfolio VaR & CVaR
decision_rationale: The formulas were useful but claims of per-step execution authority were unsafe. Methods were added as explicit advisory reports with assumptions, hashes, warnings, and no execution authority.
invariant: every report states assumptions, provenance, and advisory-only authority
negative_invariant: risk report cannot place orders or relax live limits

value_unit: headless status surface for SSH environments
donor_symbol: Missing Cell-Width Sanitized Terminal User Interface
decision_rationale: A full donor TUI was incomplete and unsafe. The target implements a smaller read-only structured status command using existing authoritative health, authority, audit, and backup sources.
invariant: status is read-only, secret-free, and non-authoritative
negative_invariant: display state cannot mutate production or grant execution authority
license_note: product idea only; no donor TUI code copied

value_unit: L2 sequence continuity, crossed-book invalidation, and snapshot resynchronization
decision_rationale: The invariant was valuable but sample code oversimplified venue sequencing. A bounded target-native state machine was implemented with explicit invalidation and no readable state before resynchronization.
invariant: only complete, sequence-contiguous, uncrossed books are readable
negative_invariant: gapped or malformed books cannot reach downstream consumers
license_note: invariant independently implemented; no donor code copied

value_unit: immutable workflow pins, digest-gated images, SBOM, provenance, and optional signing
decision_rationale: The recommendation aligns with existing release gaps. Target-native scripts and workflows now verify immutable action pins, require digest-form production image inputs, generate SBOM/provenance, and support cosign without claiming certification.
invariant: release inputs and promoted bytes are immutable and hash-bound
negative_invariant: mutable action tags or unpinned production images cannot pass release gates
migration_impact: new release workflow and explicit digest inputs

decision_rationale: The sample verifies a server-generated signature against itself, ignores the supplied approval secret, accepts but does not validate the gateway key, and lacks durability, expiry, CAS, replay prevention, and recovery. Existing target governance is stronger.
invariant: authorization is principal-bound, durable, replay-safe, and four-eyes
negative_invariant: UI or in-memory state cannot approve consequential actions

decision_rationale: The sample manufactures fills, lacks real adapter semantics and idempotent ambiguity recovery, and could duplicate orders during failover. A venue-neutral protocol remains future work only after multiple real adapters are qualified.
invariant: venue failover cannot create duplicate or ambiguous orders
negative_invariant: simulated fills cannot be represented as production execution

decision_rationale: The target already has persisted baselines, hashes, minimum-sample handling, missingness, CAS integrity, routes, and tamper tests. The donor sample fails open on empty data and would create a second source of truth.
invariant: missing or insufficient drift evidence cannot be classified as stable
negative_invariant: empty arrays cannot return a healthy PSI result
